lines.trans: Where did the bottle of expensive cognac disappear to?
Honestly speaking, I don't know at all.
And who should know if not you?
Kostya, you need to be fired from your job immediately!
It definitely stood here, I remember myself.
So that fake repairman stole it.
What an insolent, vile thief!
This bottle costs huge money.
Excuse me, I will fix everything right now.
Where did you run so fast?
I will catch up with that thief and return the cognac!
Just you dare not bring it back!
